sentences.text: Fire salamander is an amphibian and is listed as vulnerable (VU).
It grows to 28 cm and weighs 36 g.
In Mainz-Bingen there are 48 reports in ten years, mainly in March to May and August to December.
It lives on land, in water and underground, and is active by day, at dusk and dawn, and at night.
Its diet is arthropods, and it has been recorded eating Lumbricidae.
It is recorded as prey of Barred grass snake, Domestic Cat, Natrix maura and Natrix natrix.
